title: Identification of X-chromosomal genes that drive sex differences in embryonic stem cells through a hierarchical CRISPR screening approach
model: Female (1.8 XX) mouse ESCs, X-linked GeCKOx/GeCKOxs libraries
contrast: Reporter-sorted vs unsorted: SRE-Elk (3v3), Nanog (2v2), Esrrb (3v3), pMek (3v3)
paper_calls: Dusp9 and Klhl13 as central drivers; Zic3, Stag2, Fthl17 as mediators
barcs_calls: SRE-Elk 110, Nanog 77, Esrrb 42, pMek 80 genes at FDR 0.10
named_hits: Dusp9 and Klhl13 top-ranked across screens (Dusp9 #1 SRE-Elk/pMek, Klhl13 #1 Nanog)
verdict: BARCS ranks Dusp9 and Klhl13 — the paper's two validated central players — at or near the top of all four screens and correlates with the paper's MAGeCK ranks (Spearman 0.53-0.78).
